name: Tsukine Denba
source: An outgoing young journalist who moved to the city for work. This is his first time living on his own, and he's a little naive when it comes to the more practical side of life. Denba can get very passionate when properly motivated, but seldom thinks of the consequences his actions have, both for himself and for others.
